input.title: Unisex Tattoo – It Means Nothing. I Love It. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

IT MEANS NOTHING. I LOVE IT. is the tattoo hoodie for the person who got inked on impulse and has no regrets, worn at the shop, at the pool and as a gift for a friend with a sleeve and no explanation.

IT MEANS stacks over NOTHING. across the top in heavy slab capitals and I LOVE IT. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a smiling man in a red cap and a striped sweater with rolled sleeves shrugs with both palms up, his forearms covered in simple old-school tattoos: a rose, a swallow, a small ship and hearts.

Navy carries cream and faded red lettering with a cream edge around the figure; Sand gets deep brown and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this tattoo hoodie warm enough for cool shop days and long sessions?
Yes. The It Means Nothing. I Love It. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cool shop days, long sessions in the chair and chilly walks home.

How does the It Means Nothing. I Love It. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a tattoo fan?
It is a natural one. Everyone with a sleeve has been asked what it means, so it lands with tattoo collectors, artists, friends with ink and the family that has stopped asking. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the figure sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the It Means Nothing. I Love It. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
